history.note: READY by operator authority OP-LC1 (roles/Themis/prompts/2026-10-06_op_lc1/); coordinator Themis records it

title: D4 preregistration: metrics, arms, sweep and frozen reconsider-transport bounds
objective: Commit, before any baseline is observed, the D4 preregistration: metric definitions, the single-ref vs per-chain arms, the epoch-duration sweep, the frozen bounds (coordination wall fraction, non-duplicate CAS retries, p95 claim latency, abandonment), bytes transferred and repository growth per PUBLISHED and per VALIDATED epoch, the 1 GB/30-day tripwire, budgets, and the GitHub arm's caps and stop rules.
problem: OP-LC1: freeze the D4 bounds before observing the baseline; a threshold chosen after the data is not a test of the git-CAS hypothesis.
non_goals: changing bounds after any D4 data exist (a change is a new preregistration with its own manifest)
evidence_required: preregistration file + MANIFEST committed and pushed to main, its SHA an ancestor of origin/main, before the first T003/T004 run

acceptance.condition: the prereg commit precedes every D4 run receipt in git history

notes: document task: RED/GREEN are not software states here; the evidence is the prereg commit preceding all D4 data.
